lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 80% on a $-37 move from the open. BTC settled $+36 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: Momentum is not a promise: a real move reversed inside three minutes. The model prices the drift it sees; it cannot see the turn coming. Streaks end like this, not with a bang.

lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 68% on a $-24 move from the open. BTC settled $+49 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: Thin move + the cold band: a sub-70% call on a sub-$25 drift is the desk's known leak — this band has run near 50%, not its stated ~65%. The $5 rulebook's 0.70 floor exists because of calls like this.

lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 65% on a $-26 move from the open. BTC settled $+60 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: The cold band again: 60–70% calls are the desk's least honest range. Counted, printed, and the reason the real-money draft puts its floor at 0.70.
